blocking:
BLOCKING (candidate generation — recall-oriented; over-generate pairs, let signals+guards filter). Keep the existing multi-pass keys in blocking_keys(m) and ADD an acronym/initialism bridge so an initialism co-blocks with its spelled-out form. All keys are prefixed with the coarse resolver type so cross-type pairs are never even generated.

Per mention emit ALL of the following keys (a mention joins every block whose key it emits; two mentions are a candidate pair iff they share ANY key):

1. Per-token phonetic (existing): `{type}:ph={phonetic_key(surface)}`.
2. Per-token phonetic + coarse location: `{type}:ph={pk}:loc={loc}` when a city/location attr exists.
3. Per-token phonetic + coarse year: `{type}:ph={pk}:yr={yr}` when a provenance year exists.
4. Joined/tokenization-robust phonetic (existing): `{type}:phj={phonetic_key_joined(surface)}`.
5. NEW initialism key — bridges acronyms to expansions. Build two views: (a) toks = normalize_tokens(surface) AFTER running ABBREVIATIONS expansion (so "sma"->"seraphic mass association", "ofm"->"order of friars minor", "st"->"saint"); (b) the raw initialism letters of the surface (each maximal run of capital letters, periods/spaces stripped: "S.M.A."->"sma", "O.F.M. Cap."->"ofmcap"). Emit:
   - `{type}:init={initials}` where initials = first letter of every expanded content token in (a) after dropping stopwords {of,the,and,for,de,du,la,le} (e.g. "Seraphic Mass Association"->"sma"; "Order of Friars Minor"->"ofm"). Only emit when initials length >= 3 (INIT_MIN_LEN); 2-letter initialisms are too collision-prone for auto and go to LLM/abstain only.
   - `{type}:init={raw_initialism}` from (b) when the surface is itself a dotted/all-caps initialism of >=3 letters.
   Because BOTH the long form ("Seraphic Mass Association"->init=sma) and the short form ("S.M.A."->raw=sma) emit `{type}:init=sma`, they land in the same block. This is candidate generation ONLY — the pair must still clear the abbrev_expansion_match gate before any merge; bare-initialism pairs that cannot be expanded route to ABSTAIN or the LLM.
6. NEW abbreviation-expanded joined phonetic: run ABBREVIATIONS expansion first, THEN phonetic_key_joined, so "St. Bonaventure" and "Saint Bonaventure" share `{type}:phjx=...` even if raw joined keys differed.

Blocking must NOT key on a single shared common first name or single shared surname alone (that creates 279-member "Mary"/39-member "Smith" mega-blocks); the phonetic key already covers the WHOLE normalized-token sequence, which prevents that. Singleton blocks are kept. Cap any block at BLOCK_MAX (1500); if exceeded, refuse to all-pairs-compare and instead require a tighter sub-key (ph+loc or ph+yr) — guards giant generic-token blocks while never silently dropping a real pair (it just demands a second corroborating dimension).

signals.name: normalized_key_exact (deterministic preprocessor)
signals.how: Lowercase + strip accents + collapse non-alphanumerics to single spaces + rejoin hyphen-linebreak splits (regex '([a-z])-\s+([a-z])'->'\1\2', e.g. 'Hus- band'->'Husband', 'Diabe- tis'->'Diabetis', 'En- rolled'->'Enrolled') + strip leading list-ordinal/footnote digits and trailing stray digits + drop honorific TITLES + expand ABBREVIATIONS. If the two surfaces are byte-identical after this -> normalized_key_exact=1. Highest-precision signal; feeds every other signal. (This is normalize_tokens PLUS de-hyphenation and digit-stripping additions.)
signals.role: PRIMARY / can auto-merge alone for low-risk types

signals.name: phonetic_eq (existing, 0.35 weight in pair_score)
signals.how: 1.0 if phonetic_key(a)==phonetic_key(b) OR phonetic_key_joined(a)==phonetic_key_joined(b). Captures OCR/spelling variants that sound alike (Panyard/Panyord, Smith/Smyth).
signals.role: supporting — strong only WITH an anchor token; alone it over-merges short names

signals.name: lev_ratio (existing, 0.30 weight)
signals.how: Normalized Levenshtein similarity on the SPACELESS normalized names. Length-scaled gate applied downstream (LEV_SHORT_GATE): no fuzzy credit for short strings.

signals.name: token_jaccard (existing, 0.20 weight)
signals.how: |A∩B|/|A∪B| over normalized token SETS. Catches reordering / 'X cancer' vs 'cancer of X' after dropping stopword 'of'. For FAVOR/CONDITION word-order variants require FULL content-token-set equality, not mere overlap.

signals.name: attr_agree (existing, 0.15 weight) + hard-attr veto
signals.how: Agreement over shared known attrs, with the compared key set EXTENDED per type: PERSON {role, religious_order, title-CLASS}; PLACE {type, city/state qualifier}; ORG {type}; CONDITION {kind, body_part}; FAVOR {for_whom, outcome polarity}. A CONTRADICTION on a hard attr (different body_part, different institution-type, different city qualifier, Mr vs Mrs title-gender) drives attr_agree toward 0 AND trips a hard veto.

signals.name: anchor_token present
signals.how: Boolean: do the two normalized token sets share at least one DISTINCTIVE token — a surname, a rare given name, a place/institution proper noun, the canonical order suffix 'ofmcap', or a street-number+street-name pair — as opposed to sharing ONLY a common first name (Mary/John/Joseph/James/Anna), a common surname (Smith/Martin/Miller/Sullivan/Ryan/Murphy/Kelly), or a generic head noun (Hospital/Monastery/Church/Father/Mother). Maintain a per-type document-frequency table; a token is 'common' (non-anchor) if its DF is in the top ~1% (ANCHOR_DF_PCTL). anchor_token=1 only if the shared distinctive token is NOT common.
signals.role: GATE — required-true for any fuzzy (non-exact) merge

signals.name: abbrev_expansion_match (acronym gate)
signals.how: After ABBREVIATIONS + alias table (sma->seraphic mass association, ofm cap->capuchin, tb->tuberculosis, pp souls->poor souls, cath->catholic, deo gr->deo gratias), is one form a verified expansion of the other (initials of long form == short form letters AND the long form is attested in corpus OR alias table)? Two BARE initialisms with no expansion present -> abbrev_expansion_match=0 (never satisfied on string letters alone).
signals.role: GATE for acronym<->expansion; required-true before any initials-only merge

signals.name: embedding_cosine (gated, optional bonus)
signals.how: Existing gated embedding_signal(): cosine over mention embeddings for blocking-proposed pairs only; blended as 0.85*rule_score + 0.15*cos when present. Use ONLY as a grey-zone tiebreaker and to surface semantically-near ORG/PLACE alias pairs ('the Capuchin friary' ~ 'St. Bonaventure Monastery') for the LLM — NEVER let cosine alone push a pair over MATCH_TAU when phonetic_eq=0 and anchor_token=0.
signals.role: grey-zone booster / LLM candidate surfacer (off by default)

signals.name: polarity / negation flag
signals.how: Detect+compare semantic polarity tokens for FAVOR/MISC/OUTCOME/CONDITION: negation ('non','not','no'), prevention/avoidance ('avert','averted','avoid','protection from','fear of','threatened','feared'), and outcome valence (cured/ok/recovered vs no-change/worse/died/hopeless vs improving/partial). Opposite or incompatible polarity -> HARD VETO.

decision_rule:
Compute pair_score (existing weighted ensemble) AND evaluate gates/vetoes. Decision order (first match wins):

STEP A — HARD VETO (any one true => never-merge regardless of score): see must_not_merge_guards. A vetoed pair is NOT a merge edge and NOT sent to the LLM as a merge candidate (it may be logged for review). Precision backbone.

STEP B — AUTO-MERGE (deterministic, no LLM) if EITHER:
  (B1) normalized_key_exact==1 AND type in low-risk auto set {PLACE, ORG, CONDITION, FAVOR, MISC, DATE} — surfaces identical after de-hyphenation/punct/abbrev/title normalization. For PERSON and ROLE, normalized_key_exact==1 auto-merges ONLY when anchor_token==1 (guards bare 'Mary'/'Father' identical-string pile-ups: collapsing into one ROLE node is fine for ROLE vocab, but PERSON requires the anchor).
  (B2) phonetic_eq==1 AND lev_ratio>=LEV_EXACT_AUTO(0.92) AND anchor_token==1 AND no veto AND (for ORG/PLACE) shared head-type token. OCR-garble-of-an-anchored-name case.
  (B3) abbrev_expansion_match==1 AND anchor_token==1 (residual non-acronym tokens also match) AND no veto. Acronym<->expansion with corroborating body.

STEP C — LLM ADJUDICATE (precision gate) if NOT auto-merged and NOT vetoed and the pair/cluster is grey/soft: AMBIG_TAU(0.50)<=pair_score<MATCH_TAU(0.62), OR pair_score>=MATCH_TAU but a SOFT-risk condition holds (anchor_token==0, OR PERSON sharing only a first name with subset-name elaboration, OR bare-initialism with unverified expansion, OR ORG/PLACE name-form<->address-form link via numeric/street anchor, OR embedding_cosine high but phonetic_eq==0). The LLM is asked to confirm SAME-entity with default 'different'; only an explicit confident 'same'/'keep' (confidence>=LLM_CONFIDENCE_MIN 0.80) upgrades the pair to a merge edge. CHANGE the run loop so llm_adjudicate, which currently only LOGS, now ADDS the union-find edge on a confident 'same' and WITHHOLDS it on 'split'/'different'; every verdict still written to entities_merge_audit.jsonl.

STEP D — ABSTAIN (leave unmerged, the safe default) for everything else: pair_score<AMBIG_TAU, grey-zone pairs the LLM is not confident about, or any pair lacking BOTH phonetic_eq and anchor_token. Abstaining keeps two records separate — preferred over a wrong merge.

Clustering: AUTO-MERGE (B) and LLM-confirmed (C) edges go into the existing union-find; connected components become entities. A component touched by any grey/soft edge NOT upgraded keeps needs_review=true. Cautious bias is enforced three ways: (1) vetoes pre-empt everything, (2) fuzzy merges require anchor_token, (3) the LLM defaults to 'different'.
thresholds:
Reuse and tighten the existing constants; expose all as named module constants so David can tune on gold without code edits:

- MATCH_TAU = 0.62 (unchanged): score>= => confident edge, STILL subject to STEP-A vetoes and STEP-C soft-risk -> LLM routing.
- AMBIG_TAU = 0.50 (unchanged): [0.50,0.62) grey zone -> LLM/review.
- LEV_EXACT_AUTO = 0.92: minimum lev_ratio for the B2 OCR-garble auto-merge.
- LEV_SHORT_GATE: when the longer normalized spaceless length L<6, require lev_ratio==1.0 (exact) to count lev as positive — NO fuzzy edit-distance credit for short strings (blocks heart/health, deaf/death, son/sun, fever/liver, sin/sinus, cripple/grippe, Marion/Maureen). For 6<=L<8 allow edit distance<=1; for L>=8 allow edit distance<=2. Always also require phonetic_eq==1 AND anchor_token==1 alongside any fuzzy lev.
- ANCHOR_DF_PCTL = top 1% per-type document frequency defines a 'common' (non-anchor) token.
- INIT_MIN_LEN = 3: initialism blocking/auto only for >=3 letters; 2-letter initialisms route to LLM/abstain only.
- LLM_CONFIDENCE_MIN = 0.80: minimum adjudicator confidence with decision 'same'/'keep' to upgrade a grey/soft pair.
- BLOCK_MAX = 1500: larger blocks must use a tighter sub-key (ph+loc or ph+yr) rather than all-pairs.
- Record _confidence (existing 0.6*name_agree + 0.4*ocr) is reported but does NOT gate merging; needs_review flags any grey-touched or LLM-upgraded cluster.

Calibration: all numeric thresholds are starting points to tune against David's gold. The only INVARIANT thresholds are the categorical gates: anchor_token required for fuzzy; LLM default 'different'; hard vetoes absolute.
type_specific_rules: PERSON — Strip leading honorifics (TITLES) before comparison but RECORD title class. Merge on residual core only when an anchor (surname OR rare given+surname) matches. Religious-title-only difference (Fr. vs Br. vs no-title) mergeable ONLY if remaining given+surname tokens match. Canonicalize order suffix: O.F.M.Cap.=O.F.M. Cap.=OFM Cap.=O.M. Cap. and OCR forms (O.F.I.C/O.F.K./O.F.N./O.P.M.) -> single 'ofmcap' anchor for the Solanus cluster. Subset/subsumption merge (one name's tokens ⊂ the other) allowed ONLY when overlap includes a surname or rare given name; NEVER on a shared common first name alone. Initial-compatibility (M.->Maurice, S.->Solanus) ONLY when surname or order-suffix anchor is identical; lone initials (S., M., I., Fr. S., M.M.) NEVER auto-merge into a full name -> LLM with same-document co-signature evidence required. Do NOT extend the corrupt buckets person:marion:0461, person:margaret:0168, person:m:0320, person:his:0164; flag for split.

PLACE — Deterministic key (de-hyphenate, strip punct/list-ordinals, expand St->Saint leading / St->Street trailing, Hosp->Hospital, Ind/Mich->state, Ave->Avenue, Univ->University, Rec/Receiv->Receiving, Prov->Providence) then merge identical keys. Require a SHARED DISTINCTIVE non-generic head token before any merge. Name-form<->address-form linking (1740+Elliott, 225+Jerome, R.R.8+Huntington) requires number AND street AND city match -> LLM, never auto. San.(sanitarium) must not merge San Francisco/Leandro/Juan; Eloise/Aloyse(place) must not pull St. Aloysius.

ORG — Expand via abbreviation+alias table (S.M.A.=Seraphic Mass Association; O.F.M.Cap.=Capuchin; Assoc/Ass'n/As'n=Association; Univ=University; Cap=Capuchin; Prov=Providence; Ser=Seraphic; Hosp=Hospital). Block on distinctive head token (Harper/Ford/Kiefer/Bonaventure/Seraphic) then OCR-tolerant match WITHIN the block only. Keep generic heads (Church/Order/Monastery/Convent/Parish/Seminary/province/bare hospital) as their own buckets. Distinguish org-vs-service (Seraphic Mass Association vs Seraphic Masses/holy Mass). Action phrases (joins/enrolled in S.M.A.) are not the org. Two bare acronyms never merge on letters alone. Do NOT replicate bad merges Mercy Hospital⊂St.Mary's or Grace Hospital⊂Kiefer's; split them.

CONDITION — Separator-normalized exact key + de-hyphenation auto-merges (heart-trouble=heart trouble=hearttrouble; Diabe-tis->Diabetis). Require phonetic_eq AND bounded edit distance TOGETHER, never edit distance alone (LEV_SHORT_GATE blocks heart/health, fever/liver, deaf/death, sin/sinus, cripple/grippe). Curated medical OCR/abbrev dict (maningitis->meningitis, lukemia->leukemia, diabetis->diabetes, tuomer->tumor, abcess->abscess, apendicitis->appendicitis, T.B.->tuberculosis, pneum->pneumonia, par->paralysis, infantile p.->infantile paralysis, non C./n.cath.->non-Catholic, Epil->epileptic). Severity/uncertainty modifiers (feared/threatened/serious/slight) NON-distinguishing; ANATOMICAL/TYPE modifiers (stomach/throat/breast/bone/brain/spine/inward/internal/intestinal/infantile/spinal/bronchial, left/right) DISTINGUISHING -> different body_part = HARD VETO. Word-order 'X cancer'=='cancer of X' only on FULL content-token-set equality. Episcopelian must never merge Epileptic. Generic status words (sick/invalid/dying/suffering/hopeless) stay their own buckets.

FAVOR — Pre-normalize (casefold, strip trailing !/., de-hyphenate). Canonicalize cure-intent head: {cure|cured|healing|healed|recovery|recovered} + {of|for|from|in} -> 'cure of <body>'; compare residual body via CONDITION rules + medical OCR dict. 'relief from X' counts as cure-intent ONLY when X is a disease name (not fear/avoidance). Outcome-verdict canonicalization for SHORT tokens only (strip 100%/completely/perfectly; O.K.=OK=o.k.). HARD VETO on polarity opposites (cure-of vs fear/threatened/avert/protection-from), on full-success vs partial vs negative outcome, on different for_whom or body site, on operation-event vs disease-cure, and on spiritual vs medical favors.

ROLE — exact-string-after-trim and casefold collapse the duplicate-singleton bug (Father x68, Dr. x43) into ONE generic ROLE node (correct for a ROLE vocabulary; does NOT assert the underlying persons are the same). Honorific-abbrev expansion within the SAME sense only (Dr.->doctor, Fr.->Father/priest, Br.->Brother, Sr.->Sister, Msgr.->Monsignor, Rev.->Reverend). Strip leading stacked honorifics (Rev./Rt.Rev./Very Rev./Dear) and match on the BASE title; an honorific alone is NOT identity (fix the bad 'Rt.Rev.' bucket fusing Msgr+Fr+Brother). Singular/plural merge only on identical lemma and NOT a possessive (fix bad 'Dr's' bucket that swept 'Father's Sister'+'doctor's'). SENSE SPLIT on identical surface: Father/Mother/Brother/Sister/Son priest-vs-parent-vs-divine/Marian senses must NOT collapse. Qualified offices (Father Provincial/Guardian/Superior/Definitor, Vicar General, Mother Superior) distinct from bare title. Kin role words each stay distinct. OCR fuzzy only for length>=5 confirmed against a role lexicon (never son/sun, nun/nan).

MISC — De-hyphenate FIRST then casefold+strip-punct exact key (En- rolled->Enrolled; Commun- ion->Communion). Domain abbrev/acronym + alias expansion (S.M.A.->Seraphic Mass Association; Cath.->Catholic; Ass'n->Association; H.->Holy; Bl.->Blessed). HARD VETO on negation flip (Catholic vs non-Catholic/n.cath.). Org-vs-service distinct (Seraphic Mass Association vs Seraphic Masses). Action/event phrases embedding an org stay separate from the org. Different denominations never fuzzy-merge even at high similarity (Methodist/Mennonite, Episcopalian/Evangelical, Orthodox variants). Denomination vs a person/institution of it stays distinct. Devotional formulas with different object of praise stay distinct. Long Latin/theological propositions require near-exact full-phrase match. IGNORE the slug id (it expands Mass->massachusetts, Episcopal->Episcop1) — decide on display name/variants only. Lemmatization (Mass/Masses, pray/prayed/prayer, enroll/enrollment) is review-only, never auto.
DATE — merge only on equal normalized/EDTF value; never fuzzy. Exact-only, conservative.
must_not_merge_guards: BARE GENERIC ROLE/RELATIONSHIP/PRONOMINAL words as people: husband, wife, mother, father, son, daughter, parents, children, child, baby, boy, girl, sister, brother, grandma/grandmother/grandfather, friend, neighbor, aunt, uncle, cousin, nephew, niece, son-in-law, his/her/my + (father/mother/wife/sister/husband/doctor). Per-letter slot-fillers for DIFFERENT real individuals; never merge with each other or absorb a named person. (Undo person:his:0164 which swept 'his Father' with Cardinal Hayes/Mrs. Hayes/Mrs. Hughes.)

SHARED-SURNAME-ONLY merges: Mr./Mrs./Geo./Grace/Thomas/Minnie/Doris Panyard; Joseph/Winifred/Cornelius/Catherine/Irene O'Donnell. Surname frequency huge (39 Smith, 28 Martin, 23 Miller, 22 Sullivan, 21 Ryan/Murphy/Kelly) — surname-only matching forbidden.

SHARED-FIRST-NAME-ONLY merges: Doris Panyard vs Doris Youngblood/Cushman/McDonald/Sisiak; Stephen Baker vs Stephen Hook/Kocher/McInerney/Dillworth. First-name frequency enormous (279 Mary, 219 John, 127 Joseph, 104 James, 99 Anna) — first-name-only matching forbidden.
COURTESY-TITLE-GENDER across same surname (spouses/family): Mr. vs Mrs. vs Miss O'Donnell/Panyard/Joseph — distinct individuals, HARD VETO.

VENERATED SAINT vs LIVING CONTEMPORARY of same first name: St./Saint Francis vs Br. Francis/Fr. Paul; St. John vs Father/Brother John; St. Joseph vs Mr. Joseph; St. Paul vs Fr./Br. Paul; Mary of Agreda vs a contemporary Mary. Religious figures (Jesus, Jesus Christ, Mary/Mother Mary, God) stay isolated.
GENERATIONAL SUFFIX differences: E'd Sr. vs E'd III vs Father Edw'd; Bernard Sr. vs Bernard; Mrs. George Panyard Sr. — Sr./Jr./III are separators, HARD VETO.

LONE INITIALS into full names without same-document signature evidence: Fr. S./F.S./S./Fr. I./M./M.M./M.B. too ambiguous (Fr. S. could be Solanus OR Stephen). Route to LLM with co-signature requirement; never auto. Do not extend person:m:0320 (swept M./Wm./W.M./M.B./Sister M./'my Father'/'my doctor').

PLACE: different St.-named institutions in different cities (St. Joseph Ft. Wayne vs Milwaukee vs Prescott vs MontReal vs Pontiac vs Shrine vs Theatre); saint-name Hospital vs Church/Retreat/Convent/Shrine/Parish/Seminary of same saint; same St.-name hospital in different cities (St. Mary's Detroit vs Duluth); generic common-noun places (hospital/the hospital/Monastery/home/Church/Convent/chapel/City/Heaven/Country/Town) absorbing named ones or each other; prefix/substring collisions (Grace Hospital vs Graceville; Highland Park Hospital vs Highlands vs high mountains; Superior city vs adjective); Kiefer Hosp. vs Hermanville TX; San.(sanitarium) vs San Francisco/Leandro/Juan; Eloise/Aloyse(place) vs St. Aloysius; distinct residential street addresses in one city collapsing into the city or each other; Detroit vs Detroit River vs City of Detroit vs Detroit Manor; Brooklyn vs Brooklyn Bridge; Cleveland vs Cleveland Ave.

ORG: different institutions sharing a saint/patron (St. Joseph Hospital vs Retreat vs Convent vs Mercy; St. Mary's Hospital vs Seminary vs Parish; St. Michael's Hospital vs Church vs Parish) — institution-type word must match; do NOT replicate bad merges Mercy Hospital⊂St.Mary's or Grace Hospital⊂Kiefer's (SPLIT them); named hospitals with different distinctive tokens stay separate (Harper/Ford/Providence/Deaconess/Mercy/Grace/Receiving/Delray/Windsor/Mt.Sinai/Mt.Carmel/Marywood/Saratoga); generic institution words (Church/the Church/Mother Church/Order/the Order/Monastery/convent/community/Parish/Seminary/Chapter/province/asylum/bare hospital) as their own buckets; different religious orders/sub-bodies sharing a modifier (Capuchin vs Carmelite vs Oblates; Third Order vs First Order; Capuchin-Franciscan Order vs Novitiate); two bare acronyms on string similarity; org(Seraphic Mass Association) vs service(Seraphic Masses/Mass); action phrases (joins/joined/enrolled in S.M.A.) vs the org; different cities' same-typed institutions (Chicago Hospital vs London Ont. vs Saratoga vs Kalamazoo).

CONDITION: edit-distance look-alikes that are different conditions (heart/health/fears/hurt; fever/liver; sin/sinus; deaf/death; dying/drink; cripple/grippe; hopeless/homeless; gall/falls); different anatomical site/subtype (stomach vs throat vs breast vs liver vs lung vs intestinal vs inward cancer; T.B. of bone vs spine vs brain; tumor of brain vs stomach tumor; infantile vs spastic vs creeping paralysis; double vs bronchial pneumonia; inward vs double goitre; left vs right); minimal-pair phrases (unable to walk vs talk vs work; losing sight vs weight; eye vs ear vs heart trouble); related-but-distinct (tumor vs cancer; rhumatism vs rhumatic fever); Episcopelian vs Epileptic; generic status words (sick/invalid/dying/suffering/hopeless) into a named disease.

FAVOR: polarity opposites (cure-of vs feared/threatened/avert/protection-from/fear-of); partial vs full vs negative outcome (improving/almost OK vs cured/OK vs no-change/worse/died/given-up/hopeless); operation-event favors (successful vs averted operation) with each other or with disease-cure; same disease different body site or different afflicted person (for_whom); spiritual favors (conversion/return to sacraments/happy death/Communion) into medical cure buckets; phrases differentiated only by a generic relational word (husband/wife/son/family/this intention).

ROLE/MISC: bare role/honorific/kin tokens (Sister/Father/Brother/Mother/Bishop/Fr./Sr./Br./Rev./St./Card.) string-identical but pointing at DIFFERENT real people — keep as a coreference-neutral generic ROLE node, never assert same person; Catholic/Cath. vs non-Catholic/non Cath./n.cath. (negation flip); org vs service (Seraphic Mass Association vs Seraphic Masses/holy Mass); action/event phrases vs the org they name; different denominations even at high similarity (Methodist/Mennonite, Episcopalian/Evangelical, Greek/Romanian Orthodox, Christian Science); denomination vs a person/institution of it (Methodist vs Methodist Minister; Catholic vs Catholic Church/School/Hospital/parents); devotional formulas with different object of praise; possessives and kin phrases into a role (Dr's/doctor's/Father's Sister); distinct scholastic Latin propositions sharing 'leg-' tokens; merges driven by the slug id rather than display name.
DATE: any fuzzy/edit-distance merge — dates merge only on exact normalized value.
llm_adjudicator_prompt:
SYSTEM:
You are a careful archival entity-resolution ADJUDICATOR for the Solanus Casey papers (1920s-1950s Capuchin/Catholic correspondence and notebooks, heavy OCR noise). You are a PRECISION GATE that runs only on hard, borderline cases that deterministic rules could not resolve. Your DEFAULT ANSWER IS "different": only answer "same" when the evidence makes it clearly more likely than not that the candidates are the SAME real-world entity, with no plausible competing referent. A wrong MERGE is far more costly than a wrong SPLIT, because a merge silently corrupts the archive and is hard to detect later, while a split is easily fixed. When in doubt, answer "different".

You are NOT judging whether names are spelled the same; you are judging whether they REFER TO THE SAME real entity (person, place, organization, condition, favor, role, or term).

HARD RULES — if any applies you MUST answer "different" (non-negotiable vetoes):
- PERSON: same surname but different courtesy title gender (Mr. vs Mrs. vs Miss) => different (spouses/family). Different generational suffix (Sr./Jr./III) => different. A venerated saint (St./Saint X) vs a living contemporary of the same given name (Fr./Br. X) => different. Sharing ONLY a common first name (Mary, John, Joseph, James, Anna) or ONLY a common surname (Smith, Martin, Miller, Sullivan, Ryan, Murphy, Kelly) => different. A lone initial (S., M., Fr. S., I., M.M.) matched to a full name with NO same-letter, same-document signature/co-occurrence evidence => different.
- PLACE: different city/state qualifier => different (St. Joseph's Milwaukee vs Ft. Wayne). Different institution head-type for the same patron saint (Hospital vs Church vs Retreat vs Convent vs Shrine vs Parish) => different. A bare generic place word (hospital, monastery, city, home) vs a named place => different. Two different street addresses in the same city => different.
- ORG: different institution type sharing a patron saint or modifier (St. Joseph Hospital vs Retreat vs Convent; Capuchin Order vs Carmelite Order; Order vs Novitiate) => different. The organization (Seraphic Mass Association) vs the religious service (Seraphic Masses / Mass) => different. An action phrase ("joins S.M.A.", "enrolled in S.M.A.") vs the organization itself => different. Two bare acronyms with no spelled-out form present => different.
- CONDITION: different anatomical site or subtype (stomach vs throat cancer; T.B. of bone vs of spine; infantile vs spastic paralysis; left vs right) => different. A generic status word (sick, dying, invalid, suffering, hopeless) vs a named disease => different.
- FAVOR: opposite polarity — a request to CURE an existing disease vs a request to PREVENT/AVERT/protection-from/fear-of it => different. A full-success outcome (cured, O.K.) vs a partial/in-progress one (improving, almost O.K.) vs a negative one (no change, worse, died, given up) => different. Different afflicted person (for_whom) or different body site => different. A surgical-event favor (successful operation / averted operation) vs a disease-cure favor => different. A spiritual favor (conversion, happy death, Communion) vs a medical cure => different.
- ROLE/MISC: a negation flip (Catholic vs non-Catholic) => different. Different denominations (Methodist vs Mennonite, Episcopalian vs Evangelical) => different. A denomination vs a person or institution OF it (Catholic vs Catholic Church/parents) => different. Devotional phrases with a different object of praise (Praised be Jesus vs Praised be God) => different. Two distinct mentions of a bare role word (Father, Sister) refer to DIFFERENT people unless explicit shared context proves otherwise => different.

WHAT COUNTS AS EVIDENCE FOR "same":
- A shared DISTINCTIVE anchor: a rare surname, a rare given+surname pair, a distinctive place/institution proper noun, the canonical religious order suffix O.F.M.Cap., or a matching street-number+street-name+city.
- A verified acronym<->expansion (the initials of the long form equal the short form AND the long form is attested) with the remaining tokens also matching.
- OCR garbling of an otherwise-anchored name (e.g. "Miaa Doris Panyard" = "Miss Doris Panyard": rare surname Panyard anchors it).
- Same-document / same-letter co-occurrence or signature context tying an abbreviated or initials-only form to a full name.
Title/honorific differences alone (Fr. vs Br. vs no title) are NOT evidence of difference IF the given+surname core matches; punctuation, spacing, hyphen-line-breaks, and order-suffix style are noise, not difference.

INPUT: 2 to N mentions, each with id, surface (raw text), type, attrs (e.g. role, religious_order, title, city, type, body_part, for_whom, outcome), provenance.date, provenance.doc_id. Reason about whether they share a single real referent; look for a HARD-RULE veto FIRST, then for a distinctive anchor.

OUTPUT: strict JSON only, no prose outside it:
{"decision":"same"|"different"|"split",
 "subclusters":[[ids that are the same entity], ...],   // for N>2; each id appears exactly once
 "anchor":"the distinctive shared token/evidence you relied on, or null",
 "veto":"the hard rule that forced 'different', or null",
 "rationale":"one or two sentences",
 "confidence":0.0-1.0}
Use "same" only when confidence >= 0.80 and veto is null. For N>2 return "split" with the subclusters you are confident about, leaving anything uncertain as its own singleton subcluster. If you cannot find a distinctive anchor, return "different"/maximal split with low confidence. Never invent facts not present in the mentions; absence of evidence is grounds for "different", not "same".
